doc.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15

title: Where they lived and what Chris looked like
summary: Edna gives their Robinson Street and Villere addresses and describes Chris as dark, heavy set, with a cigar and derby.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I see. Um... Where, where, when you, where did you live with, with Chris?
We lived on Robinson between Conte and Bienville. Yes. 326 North Robinson Street. Then we moved from there and we lived on Villery Street. Right around the corner. I see.
And, um, um, can you tell me something about, uh, what did Chris looked like?

Well, he was a dark man, kind of flat nose. Oh. Had one red spot right here on his lip. Mm-hmm. From the corner. Always had a cigar, but, uh, cigar butt, not the whole cigar. Yeah. In his mouth. And wore a derby. Yes. How tall was he? About your sound. About your height. Yes.
But he was a, he was a very heavy set.
